title: feat(objectql, cli, metadata-protocol, spec, runtime)!: a namespace never equals an object name at every door
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ff4UJdxHJzwSQG7VEko8ou)_ Fixes #31681 ADR-0150 child K (D6, Q3 = A, ruling 6724530715). Claim 6734122356 (`domain:server#1`, card-thread session_01ADHkmQv69sQL5nfT8xuPWs). Clause-②: no (narrowing) — measured on head 8ef0c1689 (main merged at 97458bad6 + main), and for base by the ablations below that remove each added call: `defineStack`, `os validate` / `os build`, the package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`, so `POST /api/v1/packages` too), the Studio object doors (publish-mode save, per-item publish, `publishPackageDrafts` pre-flight) and `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish` each refuse what they accepted on base: a namespace equal to an object name in either direction, or an object short-named `custom` (`NS_custom`). Nothing is widened. Metadata-protocol: narrowed Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` does not teach a namespace spelled like an object name, or an object named `NS_custom`; the rule ships in the refusal text and in ADR-0150 D6. **`packages/spec` exception (seat ruling, option A, 2026-11-09T06:51Z, restated in claim 6734122356):** the standard order bars `packages/spec/**`. The seat granted exactly one call to P's `findNamespaceObjectNameClashes` in `stack.zod.ts`, beside `validateNamespacePrefix`, plus its test. No schema key, no schema shape change, no second predicate. That is all this PR does there, and the changeset bumps `@objectstack/spec` minor for it. This is a narrowing, so the review of record runs at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：命名空间永远不能等于对象名（ADR-0150 D6，你裁定的 Q3 = A），对象也不能短名为 `custom`（`NS_custom`）。规格卡 P 的谓词 `findNamespaceObjectNameClashes` 现在接到所有入口：`defineStack`、`os validate` / `os build`、安装门、Studio 的保存 / 单项发布 / 批量发布预检 / 草稿判定，以及 `POST /packages/:id/publish`。双向拒绝，消息里点出两种拼写和两个包。 - 为什么改：AI 面拼作 `NS-NAME` 和 `OBJECT-ACTION`，命名空间和对象名相同会让一个地址指向两样东西。谓词已在 P 里，但没有任何入口调用它。 - 风险与回滚：只收窄。第一方 0 处。已有这种冲突的部署升级后启动失败，并点名双方。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`registry.ts` 的 `refuseNamespaceObjectNameClashes`，`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` 的 `namespaceObjectNameClashOf`（Studio 各门和运行时发布门共用的判定），`stack.zod.ts` 的 `validateNamespacePrefix`（唯一一处规格改动）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.namespace-object-name-doors.test.ts`，预期 7 passed。 - 需要你做的：无，席位复审后落地。超出认领文件面的两处（`runtime` 的发布门、`metadata-core` 的审计码文档）席位已裁定保留，见文末。 ## What changes - **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`**: `installPackage` calls the new private `refuseNamespaceObjectNameClashes(manifest, selfId)` after N's namespace-name refusal. The incoming package's namespace and objects (its own and its `plugins[]`', by `declaredOwnedObjectNames`) are judged against every installed namespace and every registered object whose owner is another package. The package itself is never a second holder. It throws `NamespaceObjectNameConflictError` (`NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, 422, `clashes[]`, the predicate's sentences). - **`packages/cli/src/utils/namespace-object-names.ts`** (new): `findNamespaceObjectNameRefusals(parsed)` walks every namespace and object one artifact holds: each `packages[]` body, plus the stack's own manifest with its top-level objects. It makes one call to the predicate. `validate.ts` (step 2c-ter) and `compile.ts` (step 3a-quater) refuse with it, text and `--json`. The build-gate parity roster lists it. - **`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`**: `validateNamespacePrefix` makes the one granted predicate call over the same set. Its refusals ride `StackNamespacePrefixInvalidError` (`issues` are the predicate's sentences). No new key, schema or error class. - **`packages/metadata-protocol`**: - `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` adds `objectNamespaceObjectNameClash` (the protocol method), `namespaceObjectNameClashOf` (engine-only) and `refuseNamespaceObjectNameClashes` (throws `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` / 422). They judge one object's name against every installed package's namespace (its own package excluded) and against its own package's `NS_custom`. - That judge is wired beside the `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` check at the publish-mode save (`protocol-save.ts`), the per-item publish (`protocol-history-and-publish.ts`), the `publishPackageDrafts` pre-flight (`protocol.ts`, new `PreflightViolationCode` `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, audit spelling `namespace_conflict`) and the draft verdict (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts`, rule `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`). - `refuseNamespaceObjectNameClashes` is exported for the runtime door. - **`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`**: `POST /packages/:id/publish` judges every object the metadata service holds under the package (the membership `publishPackage` collects) before `MetadataManager.publishPackage` runs. It answers `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` / 422 through `errorFromThrown`. `MetadataManager` itself is untouched: it has no manifest, so it cannot name an installed namespace (its own docblock), and its refusals are `success: false` rows, not a 422. The refusal belongs to the door that holds the registry, as `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` does. - **`packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-audit.object.ts`**: doc only. The closed pre-flight code list names `namespace_conflict`. - **`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`**: the ledger learns the new test's engine double (`--write`). - **`.changeset/31681-namespace-object-names.md`**: minor for spec, objectql, cli, metadata-protocol, metadata-core and runtime. It has both declaration lines, the BREAKING Why / Before / Now / Who moves / Unchanged, the census, the one-line fix (rename the namespace or the object) and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Forced test edits: none. No existing assertion changed. ## Step 0 (measured on `main` `cc16008a`) - **P's contract**: `findNamespaceObjectNameClashes(incoming, installed = {})`. Equality is exact and case-sensitive. Direction A: each incoming namespace against every object, incoming and installed. Direction B: each incoming object against every installed namespace. `custom`: `object.name === object.namespace + '_custom'`. Every door here calls it; none re-spells it. - **Sets compared**: - Stack time and `os validate` / `os build`: every namespace and object in the one artifact, plus `NS_custom`. - Install: installed namespaces and registered objects. - Studio and package publish: installed namespaces and the object's own package's `NS_custom`. The other direction there, a new namespace, lands through `installPackage` (`POST /packages` and the authored-package create both reach it). - **Bound (accepted by the seat)**: a declared dependency carries an id and a range, never a namespace. So `defineStack` and `os validate` / `os build` do not judge packages outside the artifact, and never guess a namespace from an id. The install door judges them. - **First-party census**: 0 first-party. - **Overlap**: 0 of the open non-mailbox PRs touch the door files. ## ADR-0150's four readings - **(a) the phase-1 one-holder tests stay green**: `bare-name-one-holder.ts` is untouched, and its tests run inside the objectql suite (580 files / 11870 passed). N's namespace-name tests run there too. - **(b) bare-name behaviour unchanged for one-holder names**: nothing in a resolver or reader changes. Each door's CONTROL shows a name with one holder still accepted: an object only starting with a namespace (`crm_lead_note` beside namespace `crm_lead`), `NS_custom_*`, the same package registering again, and an object's own package never counting as a second holder. - **(c) no migration**: nothing stored changes shape. A refused name is the author's to rename, and no conversion can choose which one. - **(d)** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` above and in the changeset; `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`; `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. ## Verification Head 8ef0c1689 (origin/main merged into 97458bad6, no conflicts). Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`. - **New tests**: install door 7 (`registry-namespace-object-name.test.ts`); `os validate` / `os build` walk 7 plus the parity roster (42 with the parity file); `defineStack` 7 (`stack-namespace-object-name.test.ts`); Studio doors 7 (`protocol.namespace-object-name-doors.test.ts`); runtime doors 5 (`package-door-namespace-object-name.test.ts`: `POST /packages` with a new namespace equal to an object, `POST /packages/:id/publish` with an object equal to a namespace, and `custom`). - **Coverage**: each door is tested in both directions where both reach it, plus `custom`, with CONTROLs. - **Suites** (merged head 8ef0c1689), each `command-exit 0`: spec 828 files / 26135 passed; objectql 581 / 11942 passed; metadata-protocol 331 (+5 skipped) / 22633 passed (29 skipped); cli 619 (+2 skipped) / 7715 passed (10 skipped); runtime 567 / 9164 passed (19 skipped); metadata 71 / 987 passed; metadata-core 27 / 1003 passed; **the whole dogfood package** 441 (+3 skipped) / 3662 passed (42 skipped). - **Typecheck and lint**: `tsc --noEmit` passes for spec, objectql, cli, metadata-protocol, runtime and metadata-core. `eslint --no-inline-config` passes on every changed file. - **Gates**: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 108 families on the merged head 8ef0c1689; all 108 ran, exit 0. `--ran` reconcile: 108 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first round surfaced three findings, now fixed: `check:error-code-provenance` (the CLI rows no longer stamp a wire code, and the runtime door throws metadata-protocol's ledgered refusal), `check:engine-double-contract` (ledger `--write`), and `check:test-source-alias` (module-top `@objectstack/lint` import). `check:type-check-debt`: 0 entries above their numbers.
Ablations (on the committed code, each file restored and checked with git diff --quiet) 1. `registry.ts`: `this.refuseNamespaceObjectNameClashes(manifest, selfId);` replaced by `void 0;` → **3 of 7 red**: both directions and `custom` install. 2. `protocol-save.ts`: save-door judge forced to `null` → **2 of 7 red**: the save refusal and the `custom` save. 3. `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`: per-item judge forced to `null` → **1 of 7 red**: the per-item publish promotes. 4. `protocol.ts`: pre-flight judge forced to `null` → **1 of 7 red**. With two offending drafts, the promotion stops at the first and calls the second `BATCH_ABORTED`; the pre-flight names both `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`. 5. `protocol-authoring-gate.ts`: draft-verdict judge forced to `null` → **1 of 7 red**: the draft reads with no `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`. 6. `runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`: the door's refusal call removed → **2 of 5 red**: the publish and `custom` cases publish (200). 7. `stack.zod.ts`: the predicate call replaced by `void findNamespaceObjectNameClashes;` → **5 of 7 red**: every refusal; the CONTROLs stay green. 8. `validate.ts`: the call renamed away → **3 of 35 red** in the parity test. `compile.ts` holds the same call, so the parity roster turns red if either command drops it.
## Open questions (ruled by the seat) 1. **Surface beyond the claim.** The claim names cli, objectql `registry.ts`, metadata-protocol and the `stack.zod.ts` wiring. This PR also touches: - `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`: the `POST /packages/:id/publish` door. That is where `MetadataManager.publishPackage` makes a package's objects live, and the only place holding the registry. - `packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-audit.object.ts`: doc comment only. It is the closed pre-flight code list the `PREFLIGHT_AUDIT_CODE` record points to. Options: A, keep them (as built); B, drop the runtime door and state the bound. Recommendation: A, because without it Studio "全部发布" publishes a clashing object with no refusal. **Seat ruling: keep (A).** 2. **New pre-flight code `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` / audit spelling `namespace_conflict`.** It reuses the install door's ledgered code (listed under `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` already) and adds one value to the closed pre-flight set. Recommendation: keep, since `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` names a different rule. **Seat ruling: keep.** 3. **`defineStack` header.** A K clash rides `StackNamespacePrefixInvalidError`, whose header says "namespace-prefix validation failed" and whose hint is about the prefix. The `issues` and the lines are the predicate's own sentences. A separate error class would be a new spec export, beyond the granted exception. Recommendation: keep. **Seat ruling: keep; the message names the clash and both spellings, pinned in `stack-namespace-object-name.test.ts` (`err.message` contains both packages' spellings, `issues` equal the predicate's sentences).** - **Names** (seat's call, house conventions): `NamespaceObjectNameConflictError`, `SchemaRegistry.refuseNamespaceObjectNameClashes` (private), `findNamespaceObjectNameRefusals`, `objectNamespaceObjectNameClash`, `namespaceObjectNameClashOf`, `refuseNamespaceObjectNameClashes` (metadata-protocol export). No new error code. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01ADHkmQv69sQL5nfT8xuPWs)_ 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01ADHkmQv69sQL5nfT8xuPWs
